description: Original polished HD-2D game pixel-art single isolated static sprite. Fixed camera looks down 35 degrees from above, orthographic-like three-quarter volume, not a flat side elevation. Clear readable silhouette, deliberately placed crisp pixel clusters, natural low-saturation midtone colors, detailed but not noisy, soft colored contour accents rather than heavy black outlines. Neutral broad diffuse daytime material color for later real-time lighting: no night tint, no glow, no colored rim light, no directional cast shadow, no ground, no platform, no scenery, no text, no checkerboard. Entire subject visible with a few transparent margin pixels, transparent RGBA background. One magnificent ancient broadleaf OAK TREE, entire crown and root base visible. 6.5m tall, broad irregular asymmetric rounded DENSE FULL canopy of large overlapping three-dimensional leaf-cluster masses. Crown should occupy upper 70 percent of silhouette with dense foliage; only small beautiful negative-space windows between leaves, not airy bare branches. A healthy mature temperate oak with a thick short gnarled grey-brown trunk clearly visible below crown, large roots, moss in bark crevices, stout branch forks glimpsed behind dense leaves. Muted moss-green, olive and grey-green leaves, slight warm dry leaf accents. Excellent weight, volume and organic asymmetry. Wider crown with characteristic broad oak silhouette, no perfect circles, not a bonsai, not a conifer. Do not draw surrounding plants or ground. Neutral mid-brightness material colors.
